name: contexture
description: Architectural rules primed before coding, a review pass after, safety hooks, and a spec-to-ship workflow.

security.title: Security hooks
security.description: Block rm -rf on top-level paths, .env writes, and writes outside the project.

git_discipline.title: Git discipline hooks
git_discipline.description: Block force-push to main, global git config edits, and hook-skip flags.

session_guard.title: Session guard
session_guard.description: After /clear or compact, suggest /recap when decisions may not have been saved.

wrap_terminus.title: Wrap recovery
wrap_terminus.description: After /clear or compact, suggest /wrap when a ship was never wrapped up.

coordinate_auto.title: Coordinate auto-register
coordinate_auto.description: At session start, suggest registering on the shared coordinate board.

agent_output_contracts.title: Agent output contracts
agent_output_contracts.description: After a subagent finishes, flag output that breaks its contract.

codemap_dirty.title: Codemap dirty marker
codemap_dirty.description: Mark the codemap stale when files change in opted-in projects.

rule_prime.title: Rule priming
rule_prime.description: Load matching architectural rules at session start and per prompt.
